long_biography.plain_text:
South African skipper Krasni Sutic gave the young Anton du Toit and his brother paid work preparing a yacht for charter in St Thomas. When their father took the earnings for board and lodging, Sutic doubled their pay. The boys eventually received a share, and Anton put his earnings towards his ambition to design yachts.

Sutic also competed in croquet at Helderberg Village. He entered the Western Cape Croquet Association Open in 2018. Three years later, he and Allan Jack won the club's handicap doubles championship, while Sutic finished runner-up in the handicap singles.

Sutic also competed in croquet at Helderberg Village. He entered the Western Cape Croquet Association Open in 2018. Three years later, he and Allan Jack won the club's handicap doubles championship, while Sutic finished runner-up in the handicap singles.
